firstRepair.when: 2026-11-14T19:15Z, after the locked completion and extension E1 had both ended
firstRepair.repeatedEpisodeLinesNote: 5,973 episode lines held 5,919 distinct runs: 54 lines repeated a run already recorded. These are the shared M1 runs of extension E1 (deviations file, 'Shared runs between added primaries'): the added primaries' job list asked for some gpt-4o M1 runs once per primary, so 45 runs were made two or three times. The frozen loader keeps the last record of each run, and the repair did the same; which record is last does not depend on its outcome.
firstRepair.rerunNote: The three runs whose trace was damaged were dropped and re-run, one driver at a time: the locked completion re-ran one and E1 two (complete.log 00:45:57, extension-runs.log 00:46:23 local time, UTC+5:30). Their records are the three with startedAt from 19:15:51Z to 19:16:03Z.

originalsNotKept: The damaged originals are not in this folder. A leftover copy of the post-run script ran the repair a second time at 2026-11-14T22:34Z on the already repaired folder; it found no damage and overwrote the saved copies (*.damaged) with the repaired files, so those copies were removed rather than published under a misleading name. The figures under firstRepair are that repair's printed report, kept in the run log. The second pass changed no record: it re-wrote the same 5,919 episode lines byte for byte and the same traces in one gzip member.
